heading: Eligibility and important information
body: This NHS service is available to eligible patients for specified common conditions. The pharmacist will assess your symptoms and circumstances against the relevant NHS clinical pathway. A consultation does not guarantee treatment or the supply of a medicine. Where appropriate, you may be advised to seek care from another healthcare professional. NHS prescription charges may apply to medicines supplied unless you are exempt.

contentApproval.note: Reviewer identity confirmation is not approval of this page content. A designated clinical reviewer must explicitly approve this wording.
